# `vl restore`

Restore paths in the working copy from another snapshot

```text
vl restore [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...
```

Arguments:

| | |
|---|---|
| `<PATHS>…` | Paths to restore (default: every path) |

Options:

| | |
|---|---|
| `--from <FROM>` | Source snapshot (default: @-) (default: `@-`) |
